description: This file defines the LabelInfo class, which manages label keys, comments, associated file names, and localized label values for label management within the OFBiz framework.

classes.name: LabelInfo
classes.description: Represents label information including key, comments, file name, and localized label values.

methods.name: LabelInfo
methods.description: Constructor initializing label key, comment, filename, locale, value, and comment.

methods.name: getFileName
methods.description: Returns the filename associated with the label.

methods.name: getLabelValue
methods.description: Retrieves the label value for a given locale.

methods.name: getLabelValueSize
methods.description: Returns the number of localized label values.

methods.name: setLabelValue
methods.description: Sets or updates a label value for a specific locale, with options to update or remove.
